scripts.build: npm run build:sdk && npm run build:cli && npm run build:gemma-cli && npm run build:gemma-desktop
scripts.build:gemma-cli: npm --workspace gemma-cli-core run build && npm --workspace gemma-cli run build
scripts.check: npm run check:sdk && npm run check:cli && npm run check:gemma-cli && npm run check:gemma-desktop
scripts.check:full: npm run check && npm run test:live
scripts.check:gemma-cli: npm run typecheck:gemma-cli && npm run test:gemma-cli && npm run build:gemma-cli
scripts.dev: npm run build:sdk:no-check && npm --workspace gemma-desktop run dev
scripts.dist: npm run build:sdk:no-check && npm --workspace gemma-desktop run dist
scripts.lint: npm run lint:sdk && npm run lint:cli && npm run lint:app
scripts.pack: npm run build:sdk:no-check && npm --workspace gemma-desktop run pack
scripts.test: npm run test:sdk && npm run test:cli && npm run test:gemma-cli && npm run test:gemma-desktop
scripts.test:live: npm run test:sdk:live && npm run test:cli:live && npm run test:gemma-desktop:live
scripts.test:full: npm run test:default && npm run test:live
scripts.test:gemma-cli: npm --workspace gemma-cli-core run test && npm --workspace gemma-cli run test
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:sdk && npm run typecheck:cli && npm run typecheck:gemma-cli && npm run typecheck:gemma-desktop
scripts.typecheck:gemma-cli: npm --workspace gemma-cli-core run typecheck && npm --workspace gemma-cli run typecheck
scripts.typecheck:sdk: npm --workspace gemma-sdk run typecheck && npm --workspace gemma-sdk run typecheck:tests
